title: Learning records, certificates and reporting
summary: People who finish an intranet course can download a PDF certificate with a verify code. Required training can use those intranet completions as well as the existing LMS links, and learning managers get scoped completion reports.

added: PDF certificates when you complete an intranet course, with a verify code and optional CPD hours and expiry.
A public page to check a certificate verify code (it never shows grades).
Reminders before a certificate expires, and automatic re-enrolment when it lapses so you can retrain.
Required training (My training) can treat a linked intranet course completion as complete while keeping the LMS link.
Learning reports for completion, overdue learners and CSV export, with grade distributions hidden for small groups.
A decision record that SCORM, H5P, xAPI and LTI are not used unless Bambie separately approves one.

internal_notes: Epic #164. Shipped as v0.6.12 (milestone retitled from v0.6.8; latest tag was already v0.6.11). Issues #186 standards, #183 certificates/CPD/expiry (dompdf), #184 HR–Learning bridge, #185 scoped reports. Moodle untouched. Env: LEARNING_REPORT_MIN_GROUP_SIZE (default 5).
